prompt: Write a main method that prints its command-line arguments in reverse order on one line, separated by single spaces.
explanation: Walking the array with an index from args.length - 1 down to 0 visits the arguments in reverse without modifying anything. Building the line in a StringBuilder and appending a space only when more elements remain (i > 0) avoids the classic trailing-space bug. A single println at the end prints the whole line -- and with zero arguments the builder is empty, so println emits exactly the required empty line.
hints: Use a counting loop: for (int i = args.length - 1; i >= 0; i--).
Collect the pieces in a StringBuilder instead of printing each one, so you control the separators.
Append a space only when i > 0 -- that puts spaces between words but never after the last one. Finish with one println.
